name: slumbering_cerberus_morbid_untaps_on_the_opponents_end_step
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Morbid — At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, untap this creature.' The Cerberus attacks on turn 1 (seat 1 takes 4) and stays tapped; nothing dies in turn 1, so seat 0's end step leaves it tapped. In seat 1's turn 2 seat 0's Bear dies (2 damage from seat 0's Cub, another effect's): at the beginning of seat 1's end step, each end step, the Cerberus untaps.
